abstract_zh: 本发明提供一种制备环磺酮的方法，其特征在于，包括如下的任意一个步骤。
title_en_note: Not the patent's own English title line, which reads 'METHOD FOR PREPARING CYCLOSULFONONE, AND INTERMEDIATES'. 环磺酮 is the Chinese common name of tembotrione; 'cyclosulfonone' is a character-by-character gloss (环 cyclic + 磺 sulfo + 酮 ketone) and is not the name of any registered herbicide. The front-page abstract scheme is 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxymethyl)-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid going to its 3-oxocyclohex-1-enyl ester, which is the last intermediate on the tembotrione route, and the CN family member of this same application, CN119137097A, is titled 'Preparation method and intermediate of tembotrione'.
